applies: Router package backup/restore; shared Windows and Debian Python logic
implementation: Recover consumed initialization files from exact authenticated originals. Capture current permitted per-package UCI settings independently; schema 2 restores affected same-version settings after native installation hooks and verifies resulting file hashes. Read schema 1 and schema 2; schema 1 is still emitted if no settings are present. The installation payload remains rebuilt from current files and recovered originals rather than a wholesale replacement with stock package files.
safeguards: local common then capture exact profile and version; shared read leases, lazy catalog loading
official stable online fallback with existing proxy/download policy and SHA256; no different version substitution
ordinary missing payload stops; no script execution or installation during backup
native APK signature verification and extraction in unique private workspace; no allow-untrusted during extraction
bounded archives, cancellation, original-source provenance and final database identity check
old snapshots and additive-only restore remain supported
limitations: Customer router live backup and restore not performed
Exact local or official same-version originals are required; no cross-firmware substitution
Customer log omits installed Chinese package version; local exact match remains to be confirmed
Settings protection covers permitted owned etc/config files in the affected dependency closure; network, wireless, firewall and credentials stay excluded
Restored settings may require the corresponding service or router restart to take effect; no automatic unrelated service restart
New schema-2 snapshots require the updated application; older schema-1 snapshots remain readable
